name: Prairie Alpha Tooth
summary: Around Thunder Bluff, prairie wolf alphas roam Mulgore’s open plains. Mull Thunderhorn needs their teeth to cleanse the Wildmane Well.

sections.title: A Cleansing Offering
sections.body: Mulgore’s wells sustain the tauren, and keeping them pure calls for rites of respect and sacrifice. Mull Thunderhorn of Bloodhoof Village needs teeth from the prairie wolf alphas that prowl beneath Thunder Bluff to cleanse the Wildmane Well. These fierce pack leaders embody the strength of the wild. Their teeth honor the balance between hunter, prey, and the spirits of the earth.

faq.q: What is a Prairie Alpha Tooth used for?
aliases: what are wolf teeth for mulgore
faq.answer: Mull Thunderhorn uses eight prairie alpha teeth in a ritual to cleanse the Wildmane Well, the final contaminated well near Bloodhoof Village.

faq.q: Where do Prairie Wolf Alphas roam?
faq.answer: Prairie wolf alphas roam the open grassy plains of central and northern Mulgore, especially around the bluffs at the base of Thunder Bluff.

faq.q: Why does a water cleansing ritual require wolf teeth?
faq.answer: Tauren rites honor nature’s balance. The cleansing calls for sacred parts taken from Mulgore’s fierce native beasts, symbols of sacrifice and the vitality of its wildlife.

angles.text: As a tauren, taking a prairie alpha’s fang honors the hunter’s sacred duty to gather what is needed with respect and return that primal essence to heal the poisoned earth.
As a shaman, you appease the spirits of the wells through earthly balance. Offering an apex predator’s fangs anchors that natural harmony.
